Antruly/libuvcpp.description: The core goal of libuvcpp is to improve development efficiency in C++ environments while preserving libuv's high performance and original semantics. It systematically encapsulates libuv's fundamental types into corresponding C++ classes and consolidates related methods into appropriate classes, making interfaces better conform to C++ conventions, everyday development more convenient, and code more readable. On this basis, libuvcpp extends modules such as memory pools, Net, Web, and SSL, providing commonly used tools and services in mainstream development to help developers quickly build and develop projects.
Antruly/libuvcpp.body:
🔧 Modern C++11 wrapper for [libuv](https://github.com/libuv/libuv) — event-driven I/O with object-oriented APIs, dual-mode async/sync support, HTTP/1.1, WebSocket (RFC 6455), and SSL/TLS.

- **Version**: `1.3.8-dev` — **Author**: `zhuweiye` — **License**: `MIT`
- **Languages**: [English](https://github.com/Antruly/libuvcpp/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [中文](https://github.com/Antruly/libuvcpp/blob/HEAD/README.zh.md)

---

## Overview

libuvcpp provides a thin, idiomatic C++ layer over libuv's event loop, handles, and requests.
It preserves libuv's performance while adding RAII resource management, `std::function` callbacks,
and higher-level client/server abstractions for TCP, UDP, HTTP, and WebSocket.

The library is organized into layered modules:

```
application
┌────────────┐
│ web (HTTP/WS) │  ← uvcpp_http_client/server, uvcpp_ws_client/server
├────────────┤
│ http2        │  ← h2 session/connection layers, nghttp2 glue (`UVCPP_ENABLE_NGHTTP2=ON`)
├────────────┤
│ ssl (TLS)    │  ← uvcpp_ssl, uvcpp_ssl_context (OpenSSL wrapper)
├────────────┤
│ net          │  ← uvcpp_tcp_client/server, uvcpp_udp_client/server
├────────────┤
│ handle + req │  ← uvcpp_loop,…
```

Buwrt/githup.description: githup is a lightweight third-party GitHub client for Android of approximately 350KB, adopting an architecture where WebView hosts the frontend and the native layer provides extended capabilities. It supports repository browsing, Issue/PR handling, Actions viewing, Release publishing, full-page translation, cloud-based APK packaging, and features a silent update mechanism with a five-ring security protection system.
Buwrt/githup.body:
# githup

Third-party GitHub client for Android. The `hup` in the name is **hub** — it's GitHub in your pocket.

The technical implementation is interesting: **WebView hosts a pure frontend single-page application, and the native layer only does what the web can't do** — network requests bypass CORS, system file picker, binary upload, download and launch installer. So the entire thing is compressed to around **350 KB**, yet covers browsing repositories, viewing Issues/PRs, checking Actions, publishing Releases, uploading files, and even letting GitHub Actions package APK for you in the cloud.

What changed in each version is recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Buwrt/githup/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) (starting from v1.1.3).

The moment you open the software, it automatically compares with this repository to check if it's the latest version: **if it's already the latest version, it's completely silent with no response at all; only when there's a new version does it prompt based on the version number rule.** The version number doesn't need to change to release a new version — just upload the new package and update the checksum value, then users will receive a reminder the next time they open it (the comparison is based on the installation package fingerprint, not just the version number). See [Update Mechanism](https://github.com/Buwrt/githup#更新机制) for detailed rules.

> This application is a third-party client for personal learning purposes and has no affiliation with GitHub, Inc. All data is obtained through GitHub's official public API, and access tokens are only saved on your device locally.

Crafter-Development-Team/Crafter.body:
# Crafter

## Compatibility Range

- Windows system
- Minecraft version greater than 1.12

## Usage

### Installation

Same installation method as other plugins

- For versions above 4.2, install Crafter_exr.zip

- For versions below 4.2, install Crafter.zip

---

-*【Since the plugin includes a compiled C++ program, being flagged as a virus is normal. If unsure, you can verify the code in [WorldImporter](https://github.com/BaiGave/WorldImporter), compile and replace it to confirm safety】*

### Import

## tint Interface Convention (Preset Authors)

When importing, WorldImporter outputs the tint metadata for each material in `importer/tint.json`. The plugin supplies according to the following conventions as needed:

- Named Biome Input: As long as the CI group exposes any one of `grass`/`foliage`/`dryfoliage`/`water`/`waterFog`/`fog`/`sky`, the plugin will add the `Crafter-biomeTex` node as needed and connect it to the corresponding output (regardless of metadata, provide if the CI wants it).
- Unified Interface (Optional):
  - `tint_color` (Color): When metadata has `kind`, biome class connects to the corresponding biome texture output, `fixed` type writes the linear constant color from JSON; when metadata has no `kind` (explicitly no tinting) write white; when there is no metadata (old exporter) do not modify this interface.
  - `tint_enable` (Float 0/1): Write 1/0 when metadata exists, allowing presets to delegate switch control to metadata; if not exposed, not constrained by metadata.
- Whether `kind` is present determines whether tinting occurs: entry exists but no `kind` means explicitly no tinting, entry/custom attribute doesn't exist means no metadata (old exporter, only perform named connections).

`tint.json` looks like:

```json
{
  "minecraft:block/grass_block_top": {"kind": "grass"},
  "minecraft:block/spruce_leaves":  {"kind": "fixed", "color": [0.11, 0.31, 0.11]},
  "minecraft:block/stone":          {}
}
```

When the same texture has multiple tint results, the exporter duplicates the material and adds a suffix (such as `@grass`, `@c619961`). The plugin does not require special handling.

## Classification Basis and Material Names

- The default classification basis (`classification basis/minecraft.json`) only uses `full` exact matching, entries are complete material names (such as `minecraft:block/oak_leaves`), no longer uses `keyw` substring matching to avoid damaging mod textures.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# WaveForge

Immersive desktop music player (Windows / Electron), supporting **QQ Music + NetEase Cloud Music** dual platforms: search, playback, lyrics, visualization, smart recommendations, seamless playback (DJ-level transitions), desktop mode and wallpaper integration. Repository also contains **Android TV** and **Apple Lyrics/Explore** multi-platform branches.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install                    # Install dependencies
npm run dev:electron           # One-click launch: Vite(3000) + API(3001) + Electron window
```

Development commands must be run from the confirmed WaveForge project root. Teams may have the working directory as the project root itself, or have the `WaveForge/` subdirectory within a multi-project/AI working directory as the project root; external automation should first verify `package.json`, `scripts/dev-electron.mjs`, `desktop/main.cjs`, then use `npm --prefix "<project root>" run dev:electron`. Do not hardcode machine-specific absolute paths in scripts or documentation.

- **Advanced Features (Smart AutoMix Beat Matching)**: The project has a built-in Python 3.13 runtime (`resources/python-embed/`) ready to use; launch `launchers/start-full.bat` or run `python-beat-service/start.bat` to start the beat service (port **3002**).
- When the beat service is not running, the application automatically falls back to Fixed Crossfade without affecting basic playback.

- **Dual-platform search and recommendations**: QQ Music + NetEase Cloud real-time search, daily recommendations, popular/trending charts, personalized suggestions

   - 🔔 **Subscribe to all dates** — get notified for all quota releases
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel subscription**
3. You can also reply with dates directly for one-click subscription, e.g., `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Supports three filtering modes:
- 📅 **By date** — only view specific dates, unlimited offices
- 🏢 **By office** — only view specific offices, unlimited dates
- 🎯 **By date + office** — exact match

> 💡 Private message bot has 1-2 second latency, if urgent please join the group.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status for all offices across Hong Kong
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap, visualizing release frequency by time period
- 📖 Includes phone appointment booking tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin dashboard, supports subscriber management, statistics overview, dual-channel broadcasts

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, notifications are pushed in the following order:

> **Group broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Private DM** (parallel, only sent to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu groups and private messages arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy and Security

- Feishu user data is encrypted with **AES-256-GCM**, not readable in the repository
- Only reads **publicly released** quota data from the Immigration Department

# Jianlan Technology JLAIharnessos · JLAIharnessos

### Hangzhou Jianlan Technology · Next-Generation AI-Powered Hospital Industrial-Grade Agent Operating System
#### Open Source · Free · Industrial-Grade Medical Agent Operating System —— Making Medical AI Simpler and More Practical, Becoming the "Android of the Medical AI Era"

**An operating system that hospital information departments can build agents on themselves: AI medical record generation, AI medical record quality control, voice-enabled electronic health records, intelligent prescription review, clinical decision support…… Drag-and-drop ready to use, private deployment, data never leaves the hospital.**

[English](https://github.com/chenweidaben/JLAIharnessos/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) · [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Low-Code Setup](#-5-minute-medical-agent-setup) · [Architecture](#-system-architecture) · [Documentation](#-documentation) · [Contribution](https://github.com/chenweidaben/JLAIharnessos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](https://github.com/chenweidaben/JLAIharnessos/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md)

---

## Why We Do This

Large models are powerful, but hospitals can't use them: **Sensitive data cannot leave the hospital, HIS/LIS/PACS systems are scattered, clinical processes are strict with extremely low error tolerance, vendor lock-in is severe, and information departments lack a programmable agent foundation.**

With the vision of "**Making Medical AI Simpler and More Practical**", Jianlan Technology has fully open-sourced its accumulated medical agent engine under **Apache-2.0**:

- 🏥 **For Hospitals**: Information departments can orchestrate their own agents on a low-code canvas, with privatization, auditability, and compliance with information security standards;
- 🧩 **For Developers**: Provides agent orchestration kernel, 38 medical tools, knowledge platform, and integration adapters for extension like installing apps;
- 🌏 **For Ecosystem**: Connects hospitals, vendors, and open-source communities through standardized "Agent Packages", building the Android ecosystem for medical AI together.

> ⚕️ **Medical Safety Guardrails**: All outputs from this system are **clinical support suggestions** and do not replace doctor diagnosis; high-risk actions (prescriptions, medical orders, critical values) require mandatory **manual confirmation/dual review**, and all patient data is de-identified.

---

## Core Capabilities

kurzemnek/transgran-monstr.description: De-identifies CRM exports before sending to AI models. Phone numbers become hashes, customer linkage is preserved.
kurzemnek/transgran-monstr.body:
# CROSS-BORDER MONSTER **Consumes personal data, leaves the money.**
--- ## Why This AI models live abroad. You can't send customer phone numbers and emails there — it's cross-border transfer of personal data, and the penalty starts at a million rubles. But you want to send CRM exports to AI: it can calculate in a minute what takes a marketer a day. The monster solves this simply: it consumes personal data **before** the file reaches the model. Phone numbers turn into hashes, names and free-form text disappear, money, dates, funnels, and UTM parameters remain untouched. What goes out are tokens by which a person cannot be identified. Everything is calculated on your computer. The program doesn't send anything anywhere, it doesn't need internet. ## How to Use 1. Export anything from your CRM — CSV, Excel, even tab-separated. 2. Drag the file onto the program. Or several at once — it will process them in a batch. 3. Click **CONSUME PERSONAL DATA**. Next to it will appear `name_anonymized.csv`, ready to send to the AI model. Before that, the program shows a preview — a decision for each column: ``` PREVIEW ────────────────────────────────────────────── [KEEP] ID [CONSUME] Name… ```

maomao94/zero-service.description: zero-service: ⚡ A Go microservice scaffolding framework based on go-zero | Out-of-the-box gRPC services and API gateway, file transfer, IEC 104 protocol, Modbus protocol, and DJI DockStation cloud API support
maomao94/zero-service.body:
# Zero-Service

A collection of Go microservices designed for industrial IoT and edge integration scenarios. The project is built on [go-zero](https://github.com/zeromicro/go-zero) and covers capabilities including industrial protocol access, stream data processing, task scheduling, real-time communication, and UAV docking stations.

Zero-Service is not a monolithic application that must be deployed as a whole. Each service can run independently as needed, or can be combined through gRPC, Kafka, MQTT, and SocketIO to form a complete business workflow.

[Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Architecture Overview](https://github.com/maomao94/zero-service/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture.md) · [Full Documentation](https://github.com/maomao94/zero-service/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md) · [Contributing](https://github.com/maomao94/zero-service/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Core Capabilities

- **Video Conference**: Real-time audio and video conferencing based on LiveKit Server, providing conference management, ticket invitations, Webhook status synchronization, and chat messaging capabilities.
- **IEC 104 Data Collection**: Multi-slave station communication with parallel data distribution through Kafka, MQTT, and gRPC, supporting ASDU merging and time-series storage.
- **DJI Cloud Platform Integration**: Encapsulates Dock 3 Cloud API, supporting flight route tasks, live streaming, and DRC command-based flight.
- **Task Scheduling**: Provides asynq asynchronous callbacks, Plan/Batch/ExecItem scheduled tasks, and RRULE-based CronJob periodic scheduling.
- **Real-time Communication**: SocketIO gateway for connection management, room broadcasting, server-side push notifications, and MQTT bridging.
- **Industrial Protocol Bridging**: Supports Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, Kafka, gRPC-Gateway, and reverse isolation device access.
- **Substation Inspection**: ISP protocol server and proxy for connecting upper-level platforms and lower-level inspection devices.
- **General-purpose Capabilities**: Includes geolocation calculations, object storage, file transfer, container management, service discovery, and observability components.

## Quick Start

### Environment Requirements

- Go 1.26 or higher
- Git
- External dependencies matching the target service, such as Redis, Kafka, database, or MQTT Broker

```bash
git clone https://github.com/maomao94/zero-service.git
cd zero-service
go mod download
```

racheko-lab/blive-monitor.description: Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + WeChat Push Notifications
racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + Multi-Channel Push Notifications

A lightweight live stream status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, automatically pushing notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server酱 / WeChat for Enterprise / PushPlus / Telegram) when streaming goes live or new works are published.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-Platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live streams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-Channel Push**: Push notifications through Bark / Server酱 / WeChat for Enterprise / PushPlus / Telegram when streaming goes live or new works are published
- 📊 **Live Stream Duration Statistics**: Record streaming duration and last streaming time
- 📝 **History Log**: Retain the latest 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Push**: Merge into a single notification when multiple streamers go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Works Detection**: Support for detecting Douyin new works publication (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitoring Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file to add streamers to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live Room ID
  - Bilibili: Room number (the number in the URL, such as `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Room web_rid (the string in the URL, such as `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Streamer name (for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Live stream / new works notifications support multiple channels, configured through the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/your-key", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or WeChat for Enterprise group bot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or...
```
